system.description:
You are particularly adept at hitting the right target in a crowd.

Prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Base Attack Bonus +4

Effect: You always ignore Soft Cover (that is, Cover provided by a character, creature, or Droid) when you make a ranged attack.

Normal: You can only ignore Cover if you Aim before making a ranged attack.

prerequisite.text: Point-Blank Shot feat, Precise Shot feat, and Base Attack Bonus 4
